interpretation: Independent-process cold start, identical initial/RNG and all200 prefix arrays; old/new recording agrees on all600 legacy arrays. Original sequential evaluation trajectories are not claimed.
Finite differences include closed-loop compensation and nonlinear dynamics. Four scene replicas are descriptive and do not provide independent-seed or global open-loop evidence.
Reward differences use the native unchanged objective over ticks200..599, with discount starting at tick200. Components and discrete events reconstruct those differences.

Saved-model critic values are CPU estimates; their tail contribution is reported separately. Reset observations after done are never bootstrapped. A400-step estimate is not the native PPO gradient or a prediction of retraining quality.
